title: Project scaffolding
lead:
Set up the repo layout, the test runner, a project AGENTS.md, and the license,
using the runtime and license the owner confirmed.
boundary:
**Not in this slice:** any dlog command or record logic beyond an empty entry
point that the smoke test can call.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Every later slice is test-first and needs a known layout, one test command, and
project guidance for agents. PROJECT.md requires the standard library only for
runtime and tests (`unittest` if Python is confirmed).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
Exact paths depend on the confirmed runtime (C15). Expected under the
recommendation: a package for the modules named in the Architecture sketch
(cli, commands, store, model, query, render), a tests directory, AGENTS.md,
LICENSE (per C22), and .gitignore updates for the confirmed stack.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
A smoke test that runs the CLI entry point with `--help` and expects exit 0 and
a usage line. It fails before the entry point exists.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Create the layout and an entry point that prints usage.
- Add AGENTS.md with: the test command, the stdlib-only rule (any new
  dependency needs owner approval), the test-first rule, and a pointer to slicer
  for work tracking.
- Add LICENSE per the confirmed C22 answer.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The test command recorded in AGENTS.md passes (under C15 as recommended:
  `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`).
- No third-party packages are installed or referenced.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
